map.倒虹吸（水头损失）埋深计算器。输入管径、流量与地形，估算倒虹吸管的水头损失与埋设: The inverted siphon (head loss) burial depth calculator takes pipe diameter, flow and terrain to estimate head loss and burial depth, for design reference of agricultural water conservancy and drainage inverted-siphon works.

map.：管长 100 m、D=0.5、v=1.5、f=0.02 → 沿程 0.02×1: : pipe length 100 m, D=0.5, v=1.5, f=0.02 → friction loss 0.02×100/0.5×1.5²/19.62≈0.46 m, about 0.7 m total including elbow losses.
map.：出口高程固定时，按损失反推进口需抬高 0.7 m 以上并留冲刷余量定埋深。: : with a fixed outlet level, back out that the inlet needs raising by at least 0.7 m and add a scour allowance to set the burial depth.

map.渠道需下穿河沟道路时以压力管穿越，靠上下游水位差过流。: When a channel must cross a gully or road, it passes through as a pressure pipe, driven by the upstream/downstream head difference.
map.高点易积气形成气阻降过流，须设排气阀。: High points trap air forming an air lock and reducing flow, so install an air vent.
